text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! Biko-san and the others invited 
us again. Would you like to come along if 
you're free?

I was also concerned about the mishap at 
the amusement park before. Deciding to 
keep an eye on her, I followed along, 
and...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Mm-hmm! What great weather... It kind of 
makes you want to take a nap on the 
grass~.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
No way! Today's my revenge match to get a 
photo with Carrotman! Let's go!

text_block_list.name: Carrotman
text_block_list.text:
Oh, you're the ones from the amusement 
park... Sorry about back then! Was the 
punch angle like this?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"Carrotman-san... No, never mind my 
order!"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
More importantly, please do a full-power 
Carrotman Punch together with Biko-san!

text_block_list.name: Carrotman
text_block_list.text: ! Got it, here I go! Carrotman, PUUUNCH!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Actually, it seems this ranch offers a 
giant cake-making experience!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Really!? Yaaay! Sounds like fun♪

text_block_list.name: Cook
text_block_list.text:
Um, excuse me. Reservations are required 
for the jumbo cake-making workshop...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
choice_data_list: C-C-Chiyono O, don't be so down—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
In that case, would the standard 
cake-making workshop be okay?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure making a cake together with 
everyone would be so much fun! ...Don't 
you agree, Akebono-san!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Let's do that! Fun and delicious is 
the most buono of all☆

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Phew~ We sure had our fun! How about we 
take a quick break here?

Back when she just "wanted to be relied 
on," she might have pushed herself too 
hard or gotten down... but now she seems 
to be genuinely enjoying the outing.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Wait, huh? Trainer? What's wrong? You're 
spacing out.
choice_data_list:
I was worried you might be pushing 
yourself too hard.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Impossible, you say... Ah, I suppose so.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe... The old me would've pushed myself 
too hard today too, just because I wanted 
people to rely on me.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Still... I realized it during that outing 
with Ticket-san the other day.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Being a doctor that patients can rely on 
isn't about what you say... or even what 
you do.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
It's about facing the patient and standing 
by their side. That is what truly matters.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
The teacher I saw in the park, and my own 
mentor... I didn't respect them just 
because they knew everything.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
It was because of your attitude of caring 
for the students. ...And also—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Even you are like that, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"I've never cared about wanting to hear 
something amazing, or what someone's race 
record looks like... Not once."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
You want to help me when I'm troubled, and 
you look out for me like this, worrying if 
I'm pushing myself too hard.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
It's because you're that kind of Trainer 
that I want to run toward my dreams 
together with you. That's what I felt...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
What's important isn't what you say or 
what you do. It's caring about that 
person... That's what I realized!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
If that's the case, I could do it from the 
very beginning. Ever since that day at the 
amusement park. Because I'm—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Chiyono O-saaan! Wanna play tug-of-war 
sumo with a cow~?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"Sumo, you say?! Yes! Leave the refereeing 
to me!"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I'm heading out! Time to continue our 
super fun day together!
choice_data_list: Go out there and show 'em what you've got!
Maybe I should try it, too.
Maybe I'll give it a try too.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I'm heading out! Time to continue our 
super fun day together!
choice_data_list: Go out there and show 'em what you've got!
Maybe I should try it, too.
Maybe I'll give it a try too.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, of course! You wouldn't believe how 
many times I played sumo referee with my 
dad!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
It's truly a case of 'a horse girl in her 
racing silks'!
choice_data_list: Umm... meaning you won't lose to anyone?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Yes! That's right! Well then, I'm off!

Seeing how she had grown, if only a 
little, gave me a reassuring feeling... 
and I felt glad, thinking I understood the 
proverb just a bit better.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Trainer...!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
How should I put it... When someone I rely 
on tells me that... my, my tail gets a 
little fluffy, you could say... or, um...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Umm, a-anyway! I look forward to 
continuing to work with you! See you!

As she dashed off into the distance, she 
seemed somehow just a little bit bigger 
than before.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? You did, Trainer!? Aren't you 
pushing yourself way too hard...?
choice_data_list: I feel like I can do it now!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
...It's not about what we do, but how we 
feel about it... Right! Alright, let's 
go!!

Afterward... we suffered a crushing defeat 
against the cow, but including that, it 
turned out to be a great, motivating 
experience...!
